audit_items.proof_trace: Both debt and collateral valuations inside `is_obligation_safe` call `get_price_with_check`, which invokes `check_price` on both EMA and spot `PriceFeedComponent`s; `check_price` asserts `clock.timestamp_ms() - last_updated * 1000 <= price_delay_tolerance_ms` (default 5 s), where `last_updated` is the Pyth price's own timestamp stored at refresh time. The transaction aborts if any price is stale, ensuring all safety-check valuations use fresh oracle data.
